baseline_models.mechanism: The subject separates itself from a source of overpowering force; the qaswarah supplies pressure and the flight is the resulting escape.

activation_trace.role: Flight and escape supply the compelled motion away.
The overpowering qaswarah, including the lion image, supplies the force from which the subject flees.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified subject moved away from something.
changed_reading.after: The movement is compelled escape from an overpowering threat.

baseline_models.mechanism: Qaswarah can name an archer, hunter, or herder, so the source of flight may be an active pursuer rather than a lion; chase, not mere presence, generates the motion.

activation_trace.role: Flight supplies the subject's response to pursuit.
The pursuing qaswarah supplies the hunter, archer, or herder role that drives the escape.

changed_reading.before: The qaswarah is simply a powerful beast.
changed_reading.after: The qaswarah may be an agent whose chase organizes the subject's flight.

baseline_models.mechanism: The flight-root's branch of foolish haste sharpens the verb from efficient withdrawal into a rash loss of composure under pressure.

activation_trace.role: Restless lightness and foolish haste make the escape disordered rather than measured.
Overpowering force supplies the pressure that breaks composure.

changed_reading.before: The subject performs a purposeful retreat.
changed_reading.after: The subject bolts with rash, agitated haste when pressure arrives.

baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of the flight root concerns probing and showing what is hidden; under overpowering pressure, the act of fleeing can function as involuntary disclosure of the subject's state.

activation_trace.role: Probing and showing convert the motion into evidence that reveals what was hidden.
Overpowering pressure supplies the test that elicits the disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Flight only reports a change of location.
changed_reading.after: Flight also exposes the inward disposition that pressure draws into view.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding turning-away becomes a donkey herd's recoil: the human refusal is recast as collective prey behavior, while qaswarah retains both overpowering-lion and active-pursuer possibilities.

activation_trace.role: Turning one's side supplies the human act of avoidance that the animal comparison redescribes.
The donkey branch supplies the concrete herd body inherited by the focus verb.
Recoil and distancing supply the herd's first movement, which the focus intensifies into full flight.
Flight completes the movement from turning aside to recoiling to escape.
Overpowering qaswarah supplies the predator-strength pole of the comparison.
Pursuing qaswarah preserves hunter or herder as a coexisting source of chase.

structural_cues: 74:49 names turning away from the reminder; 74:50 begins the comparison with كأنهم, and 74:51 completes its motion and threat.
The feminine-singular forms can track the nonhuman plural حمر as one herd image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turning-away, donkeys, and recoil immediately before the focus; I map the compared human group into the focus subject and treat qaswarah as the pressure causing recoil. Lion and hunter or herder remain materially live alternatives.

changed_reading.before: An anonymous subject escapes an anonymous threat.
changed_reading.after: The addressees' refusal of the reminder is exposed as donkey-herd recoil from overpowering or pursuing pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens by moving an enwrapped figure into rising and warning, later offers advance or retreat, and ends this response-axis with flight; the focus is the negative counterpart to standing up for the summons.

activation_trace.role: Enwrapping supplies the initial covered and inactive posture from which the opening addressee is moved.
Resolve and rising toward a task supply the positive response movement.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the summons to which movement responds.
Advancing and going ahead make forward response an explicit option.
The rear or backward position supplies the opposed movement option.
Flight realizes the backward option at maximum intensity.

structural_cues: 74:1-2 moves from being wrapped to rising and warning.
74:37 states advance or fall behind, while 74:49-51 stages turning away, recoil, and flight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated sequence of bodily movement terms around one warning discourse; I place them on a shared response-axis and read flight as anti-rising. They could alternatively remain separate physical images without a single trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a self-contained instant of panic.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the terminal counter-movement to rising and advancing in response to warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning and reminder repeatedly approach the addressees and demand response; without lexically identifying either with qaswarah, they can occupy its functional pursuing role in the focus image.

activation_trace.role: Warning that arouses caution supplies an active summons rather than passive information.
The reminder supplies the object from which the addressees have just turned away.
The pursuing hunter or herder image supplies the functional role assigned to the summons.
Flight supplies refusal as active escape from the summons.

structural_cues: Warning appears at 74:2 and 74:36; reminder appears at 74:31, immediately before the simile at 74:49, and again at 74:54-56.
The focus follows the question about turning away from the reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a recurrent warning-reminder and qaswarah's pursuer branch; I assign the warning the pursuer's functional arrow because it presses for response. A literal lion or human hunter remains the direct image vehicle.

changed_reading.before: The pursuer is only an external animal or hunter inside a vignette.
changed_reading.after: The warning-reminder functions like the pursuer from whose demand the addressees try to escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earnings hold each self as a pledged security until reckoning; this supplies an accountability mechanism that closes behind the fleeing subject, making the pursuit partly self-prepared rather than arbitrary.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring and earning supply the subject's own contribution to what follows it.
A security held against a right supplies the mechanism that prevents clean escape.
Reckoning and recompense specify the claim for which the self is held.
The pursuing qaswarah gives accountability the image of something closing in.
Flight supplies the failed attempt to leave the claim behind.

structural_cues: 74:38 states that every self is held by what it earned.
74:41-47 gives the offenders' account, and 74:48 removes the benefit of intercession before 74:49-51 stages flight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earning, pledge, and reckoning before the flight; I treat that legal sequence as what functionally pursues the subject. The live alternative is that only the reminder, or a literal predator within the simile, fills that role.

changed_reading.before: The subject flees an arbitrary outside attacker.
changed_reading.after: The subject flees consequences its own acquisitions have helped make inescapable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The confession of entering discourse with a participating crowd is answered by a herd image: collective participation in refusal becomes collective, contagious recoil when the reminder confronts the group.

activation_trace.role: Entering into talk or an affair supplies prior participation with a crowd.
Donkeys supply the collective body through which shared behavior is pictured.
A recoiling or rallying group supplies the social coordination of the movement.
The flight branch includes mutual fleeing and turns shared participation into shared escape.

structural_cues: 74:43-46 uses repeated first-person plural confessions and explicitly says 'with the plungers.'
74:49-51 shifts the compared plural group into a herd whose recoil culminates in one collective flight image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group participation, a donkey herd, and a recoiling group; I infer that imitation or contagion carries from shared talk into shared flight. Each member could alternatively be making an independent refusal.

changed_reading.before: Flight is the sum of isolated private reactions.
changed_reading.after: Flight is socially coordinated herd behavior continuous with earlier crowd participation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The image visibly stages fear, yet the following text denies fear of the hereafter and closes with protective caution; the subjects are not without fear but direct self-protective recoil toward escaping the reminder rather than the threatened outcome.

activation_trace.role: Fear appearing on a person supplies the visible affect enacted by the preceding flight image.
Putting oneself under protection supplies the alternative, correctly directed response to danger.
Flight supplies the self-protective reflex aimed at the wrong object.
Overpowering qaswarah supplies the immediately perceived threat that captures the reflex.

structural_cues: 74:53 follows the simile and says they do not fear the hereafter.
74:56 closes by naming protective caution, creating a contrast between flight and rightly directed protection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible fear, denial of fear toward the hereafter, and self-protection; I infer a reversal from absent fear to misdirected fear. The alternative is that animal fear belongs only to the comparison and should not be predicated directly of the addressees.

changed_reading.before: They flee simply because they are afraid.
changed_reading.after: Their panic reveals fear aimed at the summons, while the danger for which caution would protect them remains unfeared.

context_deltas.mechanism: A surah-level covering and uncovering cycle activates the flight-root's probing-and-showing branch: pressure does not merely move the subjects but forces concealed refusal into visible conduct.

activation_trace.role: Concealing truth supplies the hidden stance that later behavior can expose.
Removing a covering supplies the explicit uncovering pattern that sharpens the focus-root's showing branch.
Probing and showing allow flight to function as involuntary disclosure.
Overpowering pressure supplies the test that draws the concealed stance outward.

structural_cues: 74:18-23 externalizes a sequence from thought to looking, facial contraction, turning away, and arrogance.
74:32-34 moves from moon and retreating night to dawn uncovering, reinforcing a visibility sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, explicit uncovering, and a behavioral sequence; I infer that pressure causes the focus flight to disclose inward refusal. The safer alternative is that the flight-root's showing branch is only lexical resonance and the verb denotes escape alone.

changed_reading.before: Flight is only locomotion away from danger.
changed_reading.after: Flight is diagnostic conduct that makes a concealed refusal publicly legible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because qaswarah's pursuing branch spans both hostile hunter and managing herder, allowing gentle guidance to be experienced as pursuit. It remains anchored in the focus's flight and qaswarah branches and in the packet's guidance-reminder sequence. Downstream prose should say the image may stage guidance misperceived as a hunt, not identify guidance lexically with qaswarah.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward a path supplies the potentially benign function that can be misread as coercive pursuit.
The reminder supplies the guiding summons from which the addressees turn.
The hunter-or-herder range supplies the inversion between guidance and perceived menace.
Flight enacts the subjects' treatment of the guiding summons as danger.

changed_reading.before: The subject flees an unambiguously hostile pursuer.
changed_reading.after: The subject may be fleeing a herding or guiding summons because it experiences direction as predation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because qaswarah's plant image and the later branch of animals spreading to graze do not fit the ordinary predator syntax cleanly. It remains visibly anchored by the focus plant branch, the immediate donkey herd, and a packet-backed grazing image. Downstream prose must label it a speculative ecological activation and must not assert that qaswarah denotes a plant here.

activation_trace.role: The donkey branch supplies the herbivore herd adjacent to the focus.
Animals spreading out at night to graze supply a cross-domain foraging pattern.
The qaswar plant supplies a possible disturbed forage or vegetation site.
Flight supplies abrupt abandonment of that site.

changed_reading.before: Qaswarah must be the predator or pursuer.
changed_reading.after: At the furthest exploratory edge, the herd may be pictured abandoning disturbed vegetation rather than naming the threat directly.

strongest_changes: The immediate context resolves the anonymous subject into a donkey-herd image of people turning away from the reminder while leaving lion and hunter or herder readings of qaswarah coexisting.
Across the surah, flight becomes the terminal counter-movement to rising, warning, and advancing.
The following denial of fear and closing language of protection revise panic into misdirected self-protection.
The earnings-pledge-reckoning sequence makes the pursuit functionally continuous with consequences prepared by the fleeing subjects themselves.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet turned a short predator image into a motion-and-response mechanism: rise versus flee, warning as pursuit, crowd participation as herd recoil, visible panic versus rightly directed caution, and pressure as possible disclosure. The focus inventories also kept lion, hunter, herder, and plant branches separate instead of forcing one qaswarah identity.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not force a choice between the overpowering lion and pursuing hunter or herder branches of qaswarah.
The warning-as-pursuer and accountability-as-pursuit readings assign functional roles rather than lexical identities.
The flight-root's probing-and-showing branch is form-distant and should remain exploratory.
The disturbed-foraging-site outlier is highly speculative and depends on two remote branch images despite remaining packet-anchored.
